notes.title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is Out Now! ⚔️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/f92a4d80d0acad119963abf1a4d58e667ddacae0.jpg[/img]

Greetings friends!!!
We have some great news to share with you today.

[b]Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is now available on Steam! We are offering a special 15% discount during the launch period.[/b]
The game is also available on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139840/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona/

At its core this is a Souls-like game that features Metroidvania elements, filled with exploration and secrets to be found.

You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey.

[h3]Let's celebrate the game's launch![/h3]
In honor of the release, please watch the trailer and immerse yourself in the world of Makh-Abyss before fully exploring the story and finding out what actually happened after the death of Lord Derek Ericona.

[previewyoutube=PtAhNjGXCuY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Lawnmower game
notes.content:
After 3 years have gone from Lawnmower game release and game has sold rather good. Few sequels released which also good sales. Now after our team have got lot of feedback and contacts to make new version from original we have done it. Lawnmower Game: Next generation is better version from original and contains lot of new features. There will be 4 different mowers and those can unlocked when player drives enough distance. All mowers have little bit different handling and acceleration. Also more grass, objects, achievements added. Game also contains weather day/nights system and also casuallly raining system.

Check. game coming during July: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1346980/Lawnmower_Game_Next_Generation/

notes.title: Game crashing problem information
notes.content:
Some players who have some Nvidia like 1070GTX have reported crashing problems. Now it has given more information that what causes that. It is bug in Unreal engine 4.13 which game has made and we start to update game for newer game engine version, it takes some time, but hopefully solved soon

Here is Epic/Unreal own information about that
https://issues.unrealengine.com/issue/UE-42280


It may take weeks to compile project to newer version, need some modification etc, but now when we know that what causes that we can solve problem ad thanks for patience

notes.title: Problems with running game
notes.content:
Some players have reported that game not run with Nvidia 1070GTX but runs with 960M and other under 1000Nvidias. Not know which causes this. Game has tested  properly with Nvidia 940M and 1060. So I apologies for them whose game not running.

Also possible updates is under consideration
